name: qkd_d2d_p2_ref

job.purpose: q13b-kvend: ot_qkvd_kv_end on the pin-registered link-buffer tiles (PQ=2, PF=1, HT=1), replacing qkd_d2d_ref-q10 (TT -134.7 / FF -215.8 / DRC 35 on the old sbuf child view). +1 cycle per link hop.

benches.name: p2_ht_layer_exact
benches.cmd: PQ=2 PF=1 HT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh pos {RUN}/bench/ht_pos

benches.name: p2_ht_layer_mut
benches.cmd: PQ=2 PF=1 HT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/ht_neg 2

job.structural_change: link buffers replaced by the pin-registered M5-leaf tiles ot_qkvd_sbufp / ot_qkvd_fbuf8p (every face pin registered, pop registered per slice inside the tile) with ot_qkvd_d2d PQ=2 (pops issued two cycles ahead from shadows, +1 cycle per link hop, full rate) and PF=1 push pin flops; the old-flow ot_qkvd_sbuf view (clock insertion 505/280 ps, unregistered pop cone, M4-M6 pin faces) made the q10 spine run away (L 2.5 ns, FF hold -216 on input-port -> register paths) and left 35 parent-over-child shorts

floorplan_note: q8 (el1011-q-kvd 2026-10-12): link buffers at their INPUT faces -- TX buffers R0 on the S row under t_d (east half of S), RX buffers MX (din up) on the N rows under rx_flit (east half of N); RTL IRL/ORL relays (HT=1): one kept relay register per receive buffer next to its din, output relays toward r_d (S west) / tx_flit (N west); every parent hop <= ~480 um by pin/din geometry (q5b: rq_f -> sbuf din 814 ps of wire, RX sbufs had been placed at the S face)
